decisions: Hangul Zero is an explicit prerequisite rather than duplicating alphabet instruction inside Unit 01.
이에요/예요 remains authentic input in the airport scene but active copula instruction begins in Unit 02.
감사합니다 is learner-usable as a fixed formulaic chunk; this does not imply productive control of 합니다체.
The unit stays focused on greeting + one repair request + thanks, reducing first-unit grammar load.
Learner production uses the simpler frame 어디에서 왔어요? while authentic source input may retain 어디에서 오셨어요?.
Origin is taught as the lexical frame N에서 왔어요 rather than an abstract full paradigm.
Self-introduction remains a short exchange with return questions, not a memorized biography.
openHumanChecks: natural EN/DE explanation of subject omission
whether one optional job/hobby follow-up should appear on page

decisions: 저기요 is promoted to a core service-attention chunk because it is central to the actual shop scene.
이/가 now appears in learner production through ___가 여기 있어요, aligning the unit title with its assessment.
Particle instruction stays context-first and explicitly avoids particle=English subject or particle=German case mappings.
openHumanChecks: best mini-context pair for 은/는 vs 이/가

decisions: A dedicated KO/EN/DE numbers_time_dates native-usage pass was added; Unit 05 no longer relies indirectly on messaging evidence.
Real scheduling is modeled as ask → propose → confirm/correct rather than as isolated number recitation.
오후 한 시 어때요? is formulaic production; broader 어때요? grammar is deferred.
Delay-message language such as 10분 정도 늦을 것 같아요 recycles in Unit 07 instead of overloading Unit 05.
openHumanChecks: visual treatment of native vs Sino-Korean numbers
whether minutes beyond round times belong in 1A print or workbook only

decisions: Productive grammar was reduced from 에/에서/(으)로 all at once to 에 + polite request.
어디서 갈아타요? is kept as a high-value formulaic chunk; full 에서 contrast is recycled later.
(으)로 is not forced here simply because it belongs to the broader spatial system; Unit 07 provides a more natural means/channel use.
이 버스 ___에 가요? explicitly shows 에 in beginner production.
A third pedagogy layer was introduced: formulaicProduction = learner can use the chunk now while full grammar analysis is deferred.
Formulaic production includes -세요?, -(으)ㄹ까요?, -ㄹ게요 and -(으)ㄹ 것 같아요 in tightly bounded messaging chunks.
-(으)실래요? remains recognition-only at this stage.
Contact exchange is treated as a consent/boundary action, not an obligatory social step.
openHumanChecks: whether QR-code interaction remains evergreen enough for print

decisions: The productive repair set is limited to high-value forms: 다시 말씀해 주세요, 한 번만 더..., 천천히..., 잘 못 들었어요, 무슨 뜻이에요?, and short echo confirmation.
제가 잘 이해한 게 맞아요? moved to recognition/optional extension because its structure is dense for A1.
Authentic bakery-scene forms -는데요, 계신지, 몰랐어요 and -ㄹ게요 remain input-only.
The unit explicitly separates not hearing, not knowing meaning, and confirming information.
openHumanChecks: whether casual 뭐라고 했어? should remain recognition in student page or teacher note only
